_comment: Manifest of the weekly committed report artifacts and when each is due. Read by scripts/report-freshness-check.js via the pure src/report-freshness.js. MEASUREMENT ONLY - nothing here selects, sizes, prices or grades a bet.
_why: 2026-09-20: the clean-era report had not landed by 16:04 UTC against a 12:30 UTC cron and looked broken; it arrived at 16:37, 4h07m late, which turned out to be ordinary GitHub scheduler queueing. 2026-09-13: threshold-reviews had been silent since 08-02 and the silence was deliberate. Without this file there is no way to tell late from paused from broken except by hand-reading commit times and workflow YAML.
_grace_hours_basis: Observed clean-era commit lag against the 12:30 UTC cron over 2026-08-09..2026-09-20: 0h38m, 0h38m, 0h39m, 4h24m, 3h07m, 4h07m. 8h is roughly 2x the worst observed. Widen it rather than tighten it - a false MISSING teaches everyone to ignore the alarm, which costs more than a late-by-one-day true MISSING.

artifacts.label: Weekly threshold auto-tune review
artifacts.paused_reason: Deliberate, not broken: since 2026-08-02 scheduled runs pass --dry-run and the commit step is skipped on `schedule` entirely (weekly-threshold-tune.yml), because under the v2_clv regime a threshold move would be fitted to noise. Manual dispatch with dry_run=false still commits.

artifacts.label: Novig maker-fill venue test scoring
artifacts.paused_reason: The venue test itself is PAUSED (config/novig-fill-test.json) - Nick's call, daily order-marking is not sustainable once more sports are live. 4 fills collected against the 40 the pre-registration demands. This is NOT a result: a stalled test must not be read as a failed venue.
